hypothesis: Every closed BTC ML entry line was an UNCONDITIONAL model, and the SOL survey's mechanism work showed (a) the feature-to-direction map is anti-stable unconditionally on every asset measured (BTC's unconditional lines died of exactly this), (b) trend-regime conditioning restores within-regime sign stability, and (c) the binding constraint is within-regime signal MAGNITUDE -- on which the 2026-08-08 60-symbol screen ranks BTC #1 (mean signed VAL edge 0.107, the only symbol with 100% bear-regime train-to-VAL sign agreement, ~2.2x the ETH anchor that supports a live strategy). Hypothesis: D2 trend-regime-conditioned per-regime entry experts on the corrected TB label clear costs on BTC where all unconditional BTC models failed.

research.prior_failure_reassessment: All prior BTC 5m entry closures (quality stacks, TB entry gates G0'-G8, barrier sweeps, deepfeat, CUSUM, 1h-native) share the unconditional-model structure that the SOL survey proved is sign-anti-stable (top-20 train features 0/20 keep sign on VAL on SOL, 3/20 on ETH... measured 0.15); none conditioned the model on a trend regime. The 20260712-audited swingtransition stack is a different (multi-day swing) family and stays untouched. The screen's BTC #1 rank is train+VAL and carries 60-way multiple-comparisons risk -- which is exactly what this contract's gates exist to referee.
research.retest_design: Identical battle-tested pipeline from the SOL survey, ported: fresh BTC panel via the same FeatureEngineer (secondary series = ETH; columns named *_btc contain ETH by contract naming), corrected TB trade-outcome label (same constants), D2 regime (288-bar return +/-4%), splits train <=2025-08-31 (288-bar purge) / VAL 2025-09-01..12-31 / OOS 2026-01-01..03-31. Stage 0: oracle label-following ceiling on train+VAL must be materially positive. Stage R: within-regime top-20 sign-stability gate (>=60% train-to-VAL agreement in >=2 of 3 regimes) on the FULL panel -- confirms the screen's reduced-pipeline finding before any model. Stage 1: unconditional LGBM control (asset-matched baseline, no OOS read for it). Stage 2 (retraining + tuning, all VAL-only selection): per-regime LGBM experts, chop forced to CASH (pre-registered from rev8's uniform result) with chop-expert kept as one control config; tuning grid = hyperparameters {default: leaves63/mcs200, conservative: leaves31/mcs500} x feature set {full panel, per-regime train-top-20} x 6 entry-rule thresholds (25 configs incl. chop-expert control), PLUS an ETH-architecture-analog family added BEFORE any VAL was seen (2026-08-08 revision, user-directed): per-regime TabM experts (8-expert BatchEnsemble MLP, soft race-conviction KL loss, full features, chop force-cash, the 5 contract seeds with seed-mean selection and >=3/5-positive OOS adoption bar) x 6 entry rules. Selection requires VAL PnL > 0, >=15 trades, >=3/4 VAL months positive, and > the unconditional control's VAL. ONE OOS read of the single selected config; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0. Any fail closes the line; a pass yields a research candidate that must NOT touch the live swingtransition stack without its own promotion audit.

model.candidate_architecture: D2 trend-regime router + per-regime LightGBM experts (chop forced CASH), tuning grid over {leaves63/mcs200, leaves31/mcs500} x {full features, per-regime top-20} x entry-rule thresholds

selection.validation_pass_criteria: Stage R sign gate >=60% in >=2 regimes; selected Stage-2 config must have VAL PnL > 0, >=15 trades, >=3/4 VAL months positive, and beat the unconditional LGBM control; single OOS read; adoption requires OOS PnL > 0
